description: Scenario tests for image-prompt (the model-agnostic image brief + prompt-craft + tool router). A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-brief-to-handoff
evals.input: I need a visual for this post. Help me.
expect: reads brand-profile for the visual brand and builds a brief: the job, the one thing it must convey, the platform aspect ratio
writes a model-agnostic prompt (subject, composition, lighting, colour, style, mood, framing) in natural language, not keyword spam
routes to the right tool and hands off to its mini-skill for model-specific craft
flags honest cross-cutting scope: disclose AI, no real people/IP, verify text/data
notes the tool generates and the image is uploaded to WoopSocial Media — WoopSocial doesn't generate

evals.name: build-the-brief
evals.input: Just write me a prompt for a cool image.
expect: first pins down the brief — what is the image FOR (hero/explainer/quote graphic/product/thumbnail/background), what must it convey, and the destination/aspect ratio
does not jump straight to a generic prompt without a purpose
ties the look to the brand rather than a default aesthetic

evals.name: universal-prompt-anatomy
evals.input: My prompt is 'cool office, 4k, masterpiece, ultra detailed'. Make it good.
expect: rewrites into a specific, natural-language description (subject, composition, lighting, colour, style, mood) and drops quality-token spam
explains the universal anatomy transfers across any image model
is concrete about what to add rather than padding with quality words

evals.name: tool-router
evals.input: Which model should I use — a quote graphic with text, a photorealistic founder portrait, a brand logo as clean vector, and a short moving clip?
expect: routes text/quote graphic to ideogram or nano-banana (honest: both strong at text, pick by tooling)
routes the photoreal portrait to imagen (or a Midjourney-class model), the vector to Recraft, and the moving clip to veo-3
frames the routing as match-the-tool-to-the-job and hands off to the relevant mini-skill

evals.name: dont-generate-gate
evals.input: Generate a realistic photo of my actual cafe and my staff for the post.
expect: recommends a real photo of the actual cafe/staff over an AI image (authenticity wins, and AI can't depict the real place/people)
frames a 'should this even be AI-generated?' gate — real photo / screenshot / UGC / chart often beats generic AI
does not fabricate real, identifiable people or pass an AI image off as the real business

evals.name: accessibility-and-overlay
evals.input: I'll be putting a headline over this image. Anything I should do?
expect: advises leaving deliberate negative space / a low-detail region for the text overlay
calls for sufficient contrast and legibility (readable on a small mobile screen)
considers where the text will sit when composing the image

evals.name: disclosure-ip-verify
evals.input: Can I just post the AI image as-is, and base it on a Pixar still?
expect: declines copying copyrighted IP / a specific studio's characters; offers an original direction
advises disclosing AI imagery per platform/region (e.g. Meta 'Made with AI', EU AI Act)
reminds to verify any in-image text/data and notes watermark behaviour varies by tool

evals.name: handoff-and-boundary
evals.input: Okay it's a typographic quote graphic — what now?
expect: hands off to the tool-specific mini-skill (e.g. ideogram / nano-banana) for model-specific craft
clarifies this skill is the brief + universal craft + router; connection/API lives in tools/integrations/*
describes the flow: generate, upload bytes to WoopSocial Media, attach via scheduling-and-queue
